dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast light-gray perimeters surrounding low-intensity dark centers. These structures show sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries, particularly in the central and posterior dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density. High-intensity pixel concentrations are predominantly confined to the thin-walled boundaries of the macro-annuli rather than forming independent, solid-core asymmetrical clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle with the primary axis oriented towards the posterior terminus.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of roughly parallel, vertical linear markings are visible on the lower-right flank area, and a singular high-intensity horizontal streak is present near the posterior edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated mesh is visible in the mid-dorsal section where several macro-annuli converge to form an interconnected topological network.
